sponsor_explanation: Sponsor poster states one placebo participant was randomized in error after not meeting a safety criterion, retained in safety and excluded from the reported efficacy population. The participant-specific exclusion record has not been independently reviewed.
population_rule_observed: Retrieved protocol and SAP define primary efficacy ITT as all randomized patients, analyzed as randomized. No applicable prespecified exception has been established from the examined documents.

sources.location: Figure 1 participant disposition and analysis population
sources.finding: Sponsor reports the one-placebo exclusion and distinct randomized/efficacy/safety populations. A URL directory or conference year alone is not a verified original public-availability timestamp.

sources.location: Section 7 printed page 16; section 9.2 page 25; section 13 page 37
sources.finding: Final v1.0 specifies all-randomized ITT and analysis by randomized assignment. The listed PGIC analysis change does not establish authority for this population exclusion. Signed approval and complete amendment history remain unverified.

Amendment 2 defines all-randomized ITT for primary efficacy and requires SAP finalization before database lock/unblinding. Internal dates do not prove original public availability or when an exclusion decision occurred.

sources.location: Publisher online date and participant disposition
sources.finding: Publisher metadata gives July 8, 2025 online publication despite January 2026 issue dating; July 23 typesetting is also before the research cutoff. Paper reports an excluded inadvertently randomized placebo participant. Original version bytes have not been retained.
SEC filing index records July 9, 2025 availability. This exhibit is supplementary material, not the full main paper or a signed final SAP/exclusion audit.

required_resolution_artifacts: Signed final SAP, complete versions/amendments and dated approval history
Participant-specific eligibility, randomization-error and protocol-deviation/exclusion record
Documented exclusion decision timestamp relative to database lock and treatment unblinding
Primary analysis and sensitivity results including all 457 randomized participants
Original CSR population/disposition tables and relevant FDA statistical adjudication

postdecision_context.source_location: Section 14, Table 2, printed page 15; Trial 3 NCT05273749
postdecision_context.finding: The FDA label reports Trial 3 efficacy baseline denominators of 225 placebo and 231 TONMYA (456 total). This corroborates the displayed analysis population, but does not establish authority for excluding a randomized participant under the final prespecified SAP.
postdecision_context.application_index_observation: The FDA index records ORIG-1 approval August 15, 2025, Type 3 New Dosage Form and STANDARD review. Currently displayed documents are label and approval letter; absence of a listed clinical/statistical review is not proof such records do not exist.
